component.name: Forma
component.summary: Templates and vector design, free for everyone
Modelos prontos e design vetorial, livres para todos

description.p: Forma is a free and open-source graphic design application. Start from a ready-made size and have a post, poster or slide in minutes, or use the vector tools to design every detail.

ul.li: An infinite canvas with frames for each format
Shapes, pen tool with point editing, boolean operations and text
Layers, gradients, alignment, distribution, rulers and smart guides
Export frames to PNG, SVG and PDF
Your designs are plain .forma files in your own folders: no account, no internet

description.p: O Forma é um aplicativo de design gráfico livre e de código aberto. Comece de um tamanho pronto e tenha um post, cartaz ou slide em minutos, ou use as ferramentas vetoriais para desenhar cada detalhe.
Windows support: a portable zip and an installer that opens .forma files.
